latest_release.name: GestaltEdit v2.3.1
latest_release.body:
## What’s new

- Fixed the Watch setup sheet dismissing immediately on its first presentation.
- Added a native unsupported-system screen on iOS / iPadOS 26 and blocked on-device MobileGestalt access on unsupported systems. On-device editing requires iOS / iPadOS 27 or later.

## Download and signing

`GestaltEdit-v2.3.1-unsigned.ipa` is a local Release build, version **2.3.1 (14)**, containing the iPhone app and Watch helper.

Both apps carry **ad-hoc placeholder signatures with their App Group entitlements**. Re-sign both with suitable App Group-enabled profiles and preserve the embedded Watch app before installation. For Apple Watch signing and installation, see the community tool [WatchBridge](https://github.com/AdminZachary/WatchBridge), which is not affiliated with this project.

Release archive, preset/device-profile/backup/Watch/cache regression tests, signature verification and IPA integrity checks passed. The UI fixes have not been validated on physical devices.

detail.readme:
# GestaltEdit **A MobileGestalt utility that runs directly on iPhone and iPad**

Download IPA · Requirements · Install · 简体中文
Edit `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist` on-device. Capability presets, a full field editor, and backup/restore. ## Features - **Presets** — Configure Siri AI, Dynamic Island, display, iPad features and more. - **Field editor** — Search and edit MobileGestalt keys directly. - **Backups** — Automatic backups with detailed before-and-after changes. ## Requirements - iOS / iPadOS 27.0 or later - Developer Mode enabled - A signing tool such as [iLoader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader) ## Install 1. Download `GestaltEdit.ipa` from [Releases](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit/releases/latest). 2. Install [iLoader](https://iloader.app/), connect your device, and sign in with your Apple ID (used only for local signing). 3. Import the IPA to sign and install it, then trust the certificate under Settings → General → VPN & Device Management. ## Apple Watch watchOS 26 is not supported. Expand the device connection row at the top of Tools and select the active Apple Watch paired with your iPhone. For Apple Watch support, we recommend signing with [WatchBridge](https://github.com/AdminZachary/WatchBridge). This community tool can enable Developer Mode and install an IPA containing both the iPhone app and the Watch app. It is not affiliated with this project. ## Credits - [Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) — presets and iPadOS support - [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) — file access research - [neospring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) — respring implementation ## License [GNU General Public License v3.0 or later](LICENSE).
detail.readme_zh:
# GestaltEdit **直接在 iPhone 和 iPad 上运行的 MobileGestalt 工具**

下载 IPA · 系统要求 · 安装 · English
在设备上直接编辑 `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist`，提供功能预设、完整字段编辑器与备份 / 恢复。 ## 功能 - **预设** —— 配置 Siri AI、灵动岛、显示、iPad 功能等。 - **字段编辑器** —— 搜索并直接编辑 MobileGestalt 键值。 - **备份** —— 自动备份，并可查看修改前后的具体差异。 ## 系统要求 - iOS / iPadOS 27.0 或更高版本 - 设备已开启开发者模式 - 一种签名安装方式，例如 [iLoader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader) ## 安装 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit/releases/latest) 下载 `GestaltEdit.ipa`。 2. 安装 [iLoader](https://iloader.app/)，连接设备并登录 Apple ID（仅用于本地签名）。 3. 导入 IPA 完成签名安装，然后在「设置」→「通用」→「VPN 与设备管理」中信任证书。 ## Apple Watch 暂不支持 watchOS 26。 在 Tools 顶部展开设备连接栏，选择当前与 iPhone 配对且启用的 Apple Watch。 如果需要使用 Apple Watch，签名建议使用 [WatchBridge](https://github.com/AdminZachary/WatchBridge)。这是一个社区工具，可以开启开发者模式，并安装包含 iPhone 端程序和 Watch 端程序的 IPA。它与此项目无关。 ## 致谢 - [Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) —— 预设与 iPadOS 支持 - [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) —— 文件访问研究 - [neospring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) —— 注销实现 ## 许可证 [GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版或更高版本](LICENSE)。
